mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% MoM signals a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increase > 0.5% MoM does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS decline does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a strengthening supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase > 1% MoM does not correlate with subsequent economic strength.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is above 2% YoY, the combination signals an inflationary environment with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the combination of low FEDFUNDS and high CPIAUCSL does not correlate with subsequent positive market performance.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200k MoM, the combination signals a tight labor market with strong job growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with strong job growth
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the combination of low UNRATE and high PAYEMS does not correlate with subsequent positive market performance.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals a strengthening demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST increase does not correlate with subsequent economic strength.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, when GDP (GDPC1) growth slows to less than 1% YoY and Industrial Production (INDPRO) declines by more than 0.5% MoM, the combination signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY < 1% and INDPRO declines > 0.5% MoM
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of slow GDPC1 growth and declining INDPRO does not correlate with subsequent negative market performance.
